Calvert County Circuit Court Clerk Maryland

Address: 175 Main St, Prince Frederick, MD 20678, United States

Phone: +14105351660

The Calvert County Circuit Court Clerk Maryland is a vital part of the legal system in the state. As the keeper of court records, the Circuit Court Clerk plays a crucial role in ensuring that legal proceedings are carried out smoothly and efficiently. In this article, we'll take a closer look at what the Calvert County Circuit Court Clerk Maryland does, the services they offer, and how you can take advantage of them.

Overview of Calvert County Circuit Court Clerk Maryland

The Calvert County Circuit Court Clerk Maryland is located in Prince Frederick, Maryland, and serves the residents of Calvert County. You can reach the office by phone at 410-535-1600 or by visiting their website at www.calvertcountymd.gov.

The Circuit Court Clerk is responsible for maintaining the records of the Circuit Court, including civil, criminal, family law, and juvenile cases. They also handle the filing of legal documents, processing of payments, and issuance of licenses and passports.

Services Offered by Calvert County Circuit Court Clerk Maryland

The Calvert County Circuit Court Clerk Maryland offers a wide range of services to the public, including:

Filing Legal Documents

If you need to file a legal document, such as a complaint, motion, or petition, the Circuit Court Clerk can help. They will ensure that your document is properly filed and entered into the court record.
